key_insight: MIRAGE hides an LLM multi-agent system’s true communication topology by making observed reasoning traces look like they come from a different, phantom topology.
engineering_relevance: This helps protect proprietary MAS architectures and reduce vulnerability exposure when deploying collaborative LLM agents in security-sensitive engineering workflows.
method: Synthesize a phantom topology structurally different from the real one
Realize phantom edges through plausible semantic dependencies in agent traces
Suppress source-specific cues while preserving task execution on the genuine topology
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments across three topology-optimization frameworks and four benchmark datasets, showing strong reduction in topology-inference attack success with largely preserved task utility.
watch_item: The approach may add coordination complexity and could depend on careful tuning so that concealment does not degrade reasoning quality or introduce detectable artifacts.
paper_title: Concealing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Topology via Phantom Structure Injection
